The recorder-overhead proof: twelve sequential in-process suite sessions of about four seconds each (a warm-up pair plus five alternated with/without pairs, median ratio). The session length keeps the plugin's fixed per-session cost from reading as overhead, and the paired median absorbs load drift, so neither can shrink without weakening the bound the test proves.
